newsitem.title: USA: Sonoma International registers $15 mln offering.
newsitem.headline: Sonoma International registers $15 mln offering.

text.p: Sonoma International said it has filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission covering a proposed $15,000,000 public offering of its common stock.
All of these shares are being sold by the company, and National Securities Corporation of New York and Dallas will manage the underwriting.
Sonoma said it intends to use proceeds from the sale to reduce debt and to invest in other unique hotels, resorts, clubs and marinas throughout the U.S.
